definitions.explanation: Describes something that is rough, forceful, or lacking in gentleness. Can describe nature (rough seas, wild winds), behavior (violent actions, rough treatment), or manner (harsh tone, aggressive attitude).

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{荒々|あらあら}しい{口調|くちょう}で{怒鳴|どな}った。
examples.english: He shouted in a rough tone.

examples.japanese: {荒々|あらあら}しい{自然|しぜん}の{中|なか}で{暮|く}らす{人々|ひとびと}は、{厳|きび}しい{環境|かんきょう}に{適応|てきおう}してきた。
examples.english: People living amid the wild forces of nature have adapted to the harsh environment.

notes:
USAGE:
The reduplication of {荒|あら} intensifies the sense of roughness. Can describe both physical phenomena (weather, seas, terrain) and human behavior (speech, actions, temperament).

GRAMMAR:
- Prenominal: {荒々|あらあら}しい + noun ({荒々|あらあら}しい{波|なみ})
- Adverbial: {荒々|あらあら}しく ({荒々|あらあら}しく{扱|あつか}う)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荒々|あらあら}しい{波|なみ}: rough waves
- {荒々|あらあら}しい{口調|くちょう}: rough tone of voice
- {荒々|あらあら}しい{態度|たいど}: rough attitude
- {荒々|あらあら}しい{自然|しぜん}: wild nature
- {荒々|あらあら}しく{扱|あつか}う: to handle roughly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {荒|あら}い: rough, coarse — a simpler, more common form without the intensifying reduplication
- {激|はげ}しい: fierce, intense — focuses more on intensity and severity
